Cookie Settings

This page is a non-binding English translation provided for convenience. The German version is authoritative — in case of any discrepancy, the German text takes precedence.

This website currently uses no cookies for analytics, marketing or tracking purposes, and no comparable technologies such as web beacons or fingerprinting. No cookies are set by embedded third-party services either, since this website does not include social media plug-ins, maps, video/audio embeds, or captcha or chat services.

Technically necessary storage

When you visit this website, no cookies are currently stored on your device. On the server side, our hosting provider Strato records technical log files as part of ongoing operations (see our Privacy Policy, "Hosting" section). These are server-side log records, not cookies stored on your device.

Why there is no cookie banner (yet)

Under § 25 TDDDG (the German Telecommunications-Digital-Services-Data-Protection Act), a consent banner is only required for cookies or comparable storage access that is not technically necessary. Since this website currently does not use any such cookies, we deliberately do not display a consent management system that would only simulate a choice that does not actually exist.

Future changes

Should this change in the future — for example through the use of analytics tools, marketing services or convenience cookies — this page will be extended with a complete, granularly controllable cookie consent management system, and this description will be updated accordingly.
